title: EC-Council SOC Essentials
summary: EC-Council SOC Essentials is a professional certification offered by EC-Council. This independent study guide covers all 8 course modules: Computer Network and Security Fundamentals, Fundamentals of Cyber Threats, Introduction to Security Operations Center, SOC Components and Architecture, Introduction to Log Management, Incident Detection and Analysis, Threat Intelligence and Hunting, Incident Response and Handling. Every module has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam, written as realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each module the way the job asks for it.
